dedupe_keys.name: collectivite de corse public transport datasets

description: Collectivité de Corse: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. Coverage: Collectivité de Corse. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: GTFS -Transport - horaires chemins de fer Corse; GTFS - Transport - horaires des lignes de la communauté de communes Co; GTFS - Transport - Lignes privées Corse; GTFS - Transport - horaires des lignes de la communauté d'Ile Rousse B. Formats seen: ZIP, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
